text:
elaine: quick follow-up from the nightly latency incident. want to lock owners for remediation + temporary SLO handling.
tom: summary pls? numbers?
elaine: p95 steady at 200ms, p99 spiked to 1.5s during 02:10-02:45 UTC, throughput fell ~70%. error budget burn jumped to ~18% for the rolling week. root cause looks like simultaneous cold starts + backup IO overlap.
rahul: confirmed. seen this pattern twice in last 3 weeks. likely recurring.
alert-bot: incident-3055551234 created: https://incidents.redwood/3055551234.
elaine: proposal: instead of loosening global SLOs, add a scheduled tolerance window for 02:00-03:00 UTC for generator routes to avoid noisy alerts while we implement fixes.
tom: +1 for windowed tolerance. less risky than permanent change. we should notify SLA customers if this goes live.
cs-lead: product/CS note: we'll need a short message for customers on paid SLAs. keep it minimal unless it affects guarantees.
rahul: remediation tasks: 1) dashboard split warm/cold (Tom) 2) pre-warm hook for model pools (Rahul) 3) adjust backup job jitter to avoid alignment (Infra) 4) add combined alert: p99>900ms AND active_cold_starts>5 (Elaine).
elaine: owners + deadlines: Tom - dashboard + alert by Thu EOD; Rahul - pre-warm PR by Mon; Infra - backup jitter change by next Wed; Elaine - draft customer note and runbook update by Fri.
tom: dashboard query I'll add (draft): histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/generate"}[5m])) by (le, instance_warm))
rahul: tested pre-warm in staging, p99 spikes down ~45%. will upload artifacts to incident.
alert-bot: action items recorded on incident checklist.
elaine: decision: implement scheduled tolerance window + mitigation work. no global SLO change. will post exec one-pager tomorrow.
cs-lead: please include customer-impact summary in that one-pager.
tom: will add error-budget projection panel showing current burn trajectory.
elaine: thanks all. if anything blocks owners please flag here.
